---
title: "Reset the test or demo database"
subtitle: "SOP SYS-07 · Technical systems manual"
---

## Purpose

Rebuild the test database, or the shop app's demo database, from the files in
`sql/`, so it holds the latest rules and a fresh set of made-up dogs.

## Applies to

The person responsible for the shop's database, after pulling changes to
`sql/`, or to undo what was recorded while trying the app out.

## Before you begin

- The shop's app is running. See [SYS-03 Start, stop and check the shop's
  app](start-the-app.qmd).
- Know which database you mean:

| Database | Used by | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| `grooming_test` | The database tests ([SYS-04](database-tests.qmd)) and the Technical workbench | Made-up test dogs from `sql/seed/fixture.sql`, and any AI runs loaded with the Technical workbench |
| `grooming_demo` | The shop's screens at <http://localhost:3000> | Demo dogs from `sql/seed/demo.sql`, and everything recorded in the shop's screens since |

::: {.callout-warning}
## Rebuilding the demo database deletes what was recorded
Every client, booking, haircut, allergy and copy of paperwork entered in the
shop's screens since the last rebuild is deleted. Rebuild it only to start
over on purpose. Make a backup first; see [SYS-08 Back up and restore the
shop's data](backup-and-restore.qmd).
:::

## Procedure

1. Open the Technical workbench at <http://localhost:8501>.
2. In the left menu, click **Run & test**.
3. Click the **Database** tab.
4. Choose the database:
   - **The test database:** click **Reset the database…**, then **Yes, reset
     it**.
   - **The demo database:** click **Reset the demo database…**, then **Yes,
     rebuild the demo**.

   The output appears below. Wait until it finishes.

5. If you reset the test database and had loaded AI runs into it, load them
   again: on the **Scoring** tab, choose each run and click **Load into the
   database**. The runs are kept on disk and are not lost by a reset.
6. If you reset the test database, run the tests. See [SYS-04 Run the
   database tests](database-tests.qmd).

## Result

The database holds the latest rules from `sql/` and a fresh set of made-up
dogs. The other database is not touched.
